name: vsketch
category: A7. Native applications and procedural tools
role: Python sketches and the vsk CLI generate plotter-oriented line art as SVG
summary: Python generative-art framework for pen plotters, with a Processing-like sketch API, Perlin noise, shapes, and vpype integration for output. The vsk CLI runs, renders and saves sketches to SVG, with parameters and seeds exposed. Strength is reproducible seeded line art that flows straight into vpype pipelines. Line geometry only: no fills, gradients or raster.
use_when: Seeded generative line art destined for a plotter or SVG animation
Over p5.js when Python authoring and vpype output matter
Parameter-swept variants of a sketch via the vsk CLI
avoid_when: Interactive or filled graphics: p5.js or Canvas 2D
Raster or pixel-based generative art: p5.js or Canvas 2D
notes: 2026-10-26: The vsk --version flag and macOS arm64 install were not verified; vsketch pulls vpype as a dependency.

assessment.rationale: 1.2.0 released 2025-08-06, about 14 months before assessment; 1.1.0 was January 2024. Small but distinctive plotter-focused sketching layer over vpype.
